focus: Clear the publish gate: 28 tweet.drafted + 22 content.drafted in 24h but tweet.posted = 0 (no post event ever recorded); isolate the single blocking step and land 3 published posts within 12h
observations: Events 24h: proposal.created=349, insight.generated=273, step.succeeded=321, tweet.drafted=28, content.drafted=22, tweet.posted=0
Query of ops_agent_events for kind=tweet.posted returns zero rows all-time, not just 24h — the publish path has never emitted a post event
Previous scout cycle (2026-10-23T00:23Z, proposal 93657) proposed 'publish 5 drafts'; 5.5h later tweet.posted is still 0 while 11 further drafts were added
Last 6h: proposal.created=129 vs step.succeeded=63 — half of new proposals are churn, and a large share of recent proposals are observer 'Diagnose mission failure' entries
All recent drafts come from quill (and one xalt), agent_id present, mission_id mostly null — draft creation is unowned by a mission, so nothing is accountable for publishing them
opportunities: The publish path is a single unknown gate (approval / credential / writer step), not a generation problem — one diagnostic pass should unblock ~50 accumulated drafts
Bind drafts to a mission and an owner so publish work becomes schedulable rather than orphaned
Cutting observer mission-failure diagnosis proposals would free ~30-40% of proposal capacity for distribution work
risks: Unbounded draft accumulation with zero distribution — no audience, no reach data, no learning loop; growth is structurally zero until publish works
Proposal churn (349/24h) against 63 executed steps/6h dilutes execution capacity and hides the real bottleneck
Silent publish failure: no error event, no post event, no alert — the pipeline fails silently and each cycle rediscovers it
next_experiments: E1: trace one draft end-to-end (quill draft -> approval -> publish) and log the exact failing stage; produce a single named blocker with an owner — success metric: blocker identified and recorded in one cycle
E2: publish exactly 3 already-approved drafts as one batch; success metric: tweet.posted >= 3 within 12h (first ever), draft->post conversion > 0
success_metric: tweet.posted >= 3 within 12h AND exactly one named publish blocker documented
